setup.title: Voicey Setup
setup.no_permission: You need **Manage Server** to run setup.
setup.start:
Let's set up your Temporary Voice Channel system. This will create:
• A category for temp channels
• A "➕ Join to Create" voice channel
• A simple command control panel

React with {success} to continue, or {error} to cancel.
setup.done_desc: Join **{joinChannel}** to create your own temporary voice channel. Voicey is controlled with `{prefix}` commands — use `{prefix}help` anytime.
setup.already_exists: Voicey is already set up on this server. Use `{prefix}delete-setup` first if you'd like to start over.
dashboard.title: Voicey — Temporary Voice Control Panel
dashboard.description: This panel is informational only. Control your temporary voice channel with `{prefix}` commands. Reactions are used only for confirmations.
help.title: Voicey — Commands
help.description: Prefix: `{prefix}` — Voicey is a Temporary Voice Channel bot controlled with simple prefix commands.
help.field_setup_value:
`{prefix}setup` — create the Join-to-Create system on this server
`{prefix}setup-wizard` — guided setup wizard
`{prefix}settings` — open the server settings dashboard
`{prefix}settings template <text>` — set the automatic channel-name template
`{prefix}delay <seconds>` — set the empty-channel deletion delay
`{prefix}language <code>` — change Voicey's language for this server
`{prefix}prefix <new>` — server owner or administrator with Manage Server; change the server prefix
help.field_control: Voice channel controls (owner only, unless noted)
help.field_control_value:
`{prefix}name <name>` — rename your temporary voice channel
`{prefix}limit <0-99>` — set the user limit
`{prefix}privacy <lock|unlock>` — lock or unlock the channel
`{prefix}members` — list everyone currently in your temporary channel
`{prefix}add <@user>` — allow a user to always join
`{prefix}block <@user>` — block a user from your channel
`{prefix}unblock <@user>` — remove a user's block
`{prefix}invite <@user>` — invite a user to your channel
`{prefix}kick <@user>` — remove a user from your channel
`{prefix}ban <@user>` — block and disconnect a user
`{prefix}unban <@user>` — remove a user's ban
`{prefix}claim` — claim an available temporary channel
`{prefix}transfer <@user>` — transfer channel ownership
`{prefix}delete` — delete your temporary voice channel
help.field_info_value:
`{prefix}help` — this message
`{prefix}check` — check Voicey health, setup, and permissions
`{prefix}uptime` — how long Voicey has been running
`{prefix}botinfo` — stats about Voicey
`{prefix}ping` — test Voicey connection latency

deletesetup.title: Delete Voicey setup

This will delete:
• the **➕ Join to Create** channel
• the **Voice Channels** category Voicey made
• all **{count}** active temporary channel(s)

Your other channels are not touched. React with {success} to delete, or {error} to cancel.
